CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a 90-degree orbit arcing camera-left around the subject on a 14mm ultra-wide, framing with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows; grade as a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
